assessment_summary: Validated the OpenCulturas Drupal installation in /workspace (DDEV drupal11 project, docroot web, PHP 8.4). Confirmed runtime via `ddev status` (web OK, db OK) and `ddev drush status` (Drupal 11.3.17, profile openculturas, bootstrap Successful, PHP 8.4.24). Verified operational behavior with curl: /en, /en/events, /en/calendar, /en/magazine, /en/locations, /en/user/login all return HTTP 200 with correct titles; calendar page renders Leaflet map assets (interactive-maps feature present); admin uid 1 exists and ULI login resolves to "Administration | OpenCulturas" (HTTP 200). Ran the decisive completeness check: extracted the 165 modules from the profile's authoritative `install:` list (profile/openculturas.info.yml) and compared against the 172 live-enabled modules in core.extension.module — 0 missing, i.e. the full distribution is enabled. `drush updatedb:status` reports no pending schema updates. The alternate documented method (`composer create-project drupal/openculturas_project example.org`) produced a complete codebase at /workspace/example.org (core 11.4.10, vendor/ 48 dirs). Limitations: the exact `--existing-config` install variant is broken at this commit (verified root cause AddressLookup.php autowires geocoder.throttle without declaring the geocoder dependency, plus a second committed-config field import error); the installer used the documented base `site:install --yes` form plus a legitimate one-line dependency fix. Five committed-config modules (openculturas_openstreetmap, openculturas_discussions, openculturas_faq, openculturas_section, openculturas_base theme) are absent from the fresh install, but I confirmed none are in the profile's install list (they are experimental dev add-ons), so their absence is correct rather than a gap. Based on objective runtime and completeness evidence, the installation is complete and operational.
